package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for route_setup_scattered_without_router_package: Route registration split across unrelated files without a clear `router`, `routes`, or `transport` home.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func RegisterUserRoutes(r *gin.Engine) {
	r.GET("/users", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"users": []string{"alice", "bob"}})
	})
	r.POST("/users", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"id": 1})
	})
	r.DELETE("/users/:id", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"deleted": c.Param("id")})
	})
}

func RegisterOrderRoutes(r *gin.Engine) {
	r.GET("/orders", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"orders": []int{100, 101}})
	})
	r.POST("/orders", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"id": 200})
	})
}
